tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm cream in light, a green-black in dark. Every text color below is checked against it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, headings and the scotch rule on `paper` (14.4:1 light, 14.7:1 dark). Also the fill of a hovered or pressed outlined button.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `paper` (5.3:1 light, 8.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Thin 1px row dividers. Decorative only: never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Verdigris for LARGE shapes only, and the 3px focus ring (3.4:1 on light `paper`, 8.3:1 dark). Never small text.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text on a verdigris fill: 6.5:1 on light `accent-text`, 8.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Verdigris for small text on `paper` (5.5:1 light, 8.3:1 dark) and the fill of the primary button.

tokens.name: accent-bright
tokens.usage: Verdigris for small text and marks on `bar` (6.9:1 light, 6.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: copper
tokens.usage: Copper for LARGE ornament only (3.9:1 on light `paper`).

tokens.name: copper-text
tokens.usage: Copper for labels and small ornament on `paper` (5.6:1 light, 6.8:1 dark). Never marks an action.

tokens.name: copper-bright
tokens.usage: Copper on `bar` (5.7:1 light, 5.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: Dark surfaces that stay dark in both themes: the panel, the drawer, the top bar while either is open, a bottom bar, the toast.

tokens.name: bar-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `bar` (13:1 light, 11.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: row-hover-bg
tokens.usage: List row fill on hover.

tokens.name: row-active-bg
tokens.usage: List row fill when active.

tokens.name: row-fg
tokens.usage: All text on a filled row.

tokens.name: row-edge
tokens.usage: 6px left edge of the active row.

tokens.name: code-keyword
tokens.usage: Code only: magenta for keywords (`import`, `const`, `if`) in a highlighted block on `paper` (5.5:1 light, 7.8:1 dark). Never outside `pre` and `code`.

tokens.name: code-string
tokens.usage: Code only: teal for strings, attribute values and HTML tags on `paper` (5.0:1 light, 10.9:1 dark). Bluer than verdigris, so it never reads as the accent.

tokens.name: code-constant
tokens.usage: Code only: orange for numbers, constants, properties, function and attribute names on `paper` (4.8:1 light, 9.7:1 dark). Yellower than vermilion, so it never reads as the accent.

tokens.name: code-comment
tokens.usage: Code only: comments, in `muted` (5.0:1 light, 9.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: code-keyword-bright
tokens.usage: Code only: magenta on a dark `bar` block (`.pre--bar`), in both themes (7.7:1 light bar, 6.8:1 dark bar).

tokens.name: code-string-bright
tokens.usage: Code only: teal on a dark `bar` block (10.7:1 light bar, 9.6:1 dark bar).

tokens.name: code-constant-bright
tokens.usage: Code only: orange on a dark `bar` block (9.5:1 light bar, 8.5:1 dark bar).

tokens.name: code-comment-bright
tokens.usage: Code only: comments on a dark `bar` block, the dark theme's `muted` (9.4:1 light bar, 8.4:1 dark bar).

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section title under a scotch rule. 2.75rem below 768px, 3rem from 768px.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: A list item's name. Slightly open tracking. 1.625rem below 768px.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Flat color, thick rules, one typeface.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under the hero, a step above body. 1.375rem below 768px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Type does the work. Nothing is decorative.
styles.usage: Body copy (Tailwind text-xl, with leading-9 for 1.8). 1.125rem (text-lg) below 768px. Never tracked. The top bar, panel, drawer and toast keep 1rem / 1.5: they are chrome, not reading text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: One or two words, sentence case, semibold. Never capitals or small caps.

styles.name: btn-label
styles.usage: Primary and secondary button text, sentence case.

styles.name: menu-item

styles.name: submenu-item

styles.name: field-input

tokens.name: radius-none

tokens.name: radius-round

tokens.name: rosette-line
tokens.usage: Stroke width of the rosette, in its 600-unit drawing. Dark lines on paper read thinner than light lines on a dark ground.

tokens.name: rosette-verdigris
